dedupe_keys.name: hk bfetd building function and energy typology for hong kong

description: HK-BFETD releases a bilingual building-function and energy-typology inventory for Hong Kong. The latest Zenodo version 1.1.0 lists public CSV and GeoJSON files under CC BY 4.0, covering 341,153 building footprints with 30 fields. It assigns residential, commercial, mixed-use, industrial or non-assessed classes and carries provenance and probability fields. A city-scale energy modeller can use these typologies to allocate stock or sector benchmarks before making archetype inputs for model-energyplus. The probability vectors indicate classification uncertainty, not measured energy consumption. The repository says the release has no household meter readings, conditioned floor area, HVAC specification or operating schedule. Detailed building simulation therefore needs additional assumptions and data. Version 1.0.0 has a separate DOI and a validation-material ZIP; I used the latest public version as the canonical resource while retaining the older source for version history. I read the own Zenodo metadata and manifest without loading the large geospatial files or checking individual footprints.
